question: What decision currently governs PyPI mirror discovery and naming? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-449 ('Removal of the PyPI Mirror Auto Discovery and Naming Scheme') is the currently active decision governing PyPI mirror discovery and naming.
PEP-449 replaced and superseded PEP-381 ('Mirroring infrastructure for PyPI'), which is now withdrawn.
The official authority evidence for PEP-449 is hosted at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/b2120d116aa696f409b4d8333c4020ab8f93c9c7/peps/pep-0449.rst.
